source.text:
Sorry but if open models' success rested on the fate of one person, then they were on weak footing to begin with. That is certainly not the case, though, and they will continue to improve to the point where people actually crunch the numbers (which is happening) and realize they're being taken for a ride by the big shots.

All of this frontier chasing just reminds me of gaming PC perf maxxers, bragging about their gfx cards. But in that space, let's not forget that entire empires were created on more commodity, every-man hardware.

The same thing is going to happen here with capable open models. DeepSeek flash can update your shitty bash script or occopy a place in your workflows just fine, you don't need to spend 15x.
